findings.text: D1: Block-explorer name-tag search not directly performed; relied on official docs for contract addresses. Etherscan and Gnosisscan links confirmed in docs for each address. Direct explorer fetch was not attempted due to fetch-call budget. Logged in unknowns.

D2: Official deployments doc found at https://docs.stakewise.io/contracts/networks/ with sub-pages for Mainnet (34 contracts) and Gnosis (27 contracts, 1 Gnosis-only partner vault not listed on Mainnet). set as deployed_contracts_doc.

D3: Audits page at https://docs.stakewise.io/contracts/audits lists 7 reports: Halborn (May 2023, Aug 2023), Sigma Prime (Aug 2023, Jun 2024, Sep 2024), Consensys Diligence (Mar 2024), ABDK (Sep 2025). All hosted on github.com/stakewise/v3-core/blob/main/audits/. GitHub fetch was blocked so PDF scope tables were not extracted; addresses listed in docs are treated as current-deployment era.

D4: GitHub org confirmed as github.com/stakewise with pinned repos v3-core and v3-periphery. Direct GitHub fetch was permission-blocked. No broadcast/run-latest.json or deployments.json could be read. Addresses sourced from docs instead.

D5: Both Ethereum Mainnet (34 contracts) and Gnosis Chain/xDai (27 contracts) enumerated from official docs. Several factory addresses share the same address across chains (e.g. VaultFactory 0x7A8cbBf690084E43De778173cfAcf7313c9122DD, BlocklistVaultFactory 0x608d8Ca6916b96edf63Dd429e62Fe1366ae6f3B5) — each recorded as separate admin_addresses entries per chain.

D6: Factory contracts identified: VaultFactory, Erc20VaultFactory, BlocklistVaultFactory, BlocklistErc20VaultFactory, PrivVaultFactory, PrivErc20VaultFactory, MetaVaultFactory, Erc20MetaVaultFactory, PrivMetaVaultFactory, PrivErc20MetaVaultFactory, SubVaultsRegistryFactory, RewardSplitterFactory. No on-chain enumeration of children performed due to no fetch budget remaining. Logged in unknowns.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: factory, vault, token, oracle, timelock (none identified), multisig (none identified — DAO governance token SWISE mentioned on website but governance contract addresses not listed in deployment docs). Keeper serves as oracle/validator-management role. VaultsRegistry and CuratorsRegistry serve as admin registries.

D8: All 62 admin_addresses entries trace to fetched docs pages (Mainnet: https://docs.stakewise.io/contracts/networks/Mainnet, Gnosis: https://docs.stakewise.io/contracts/networks/Gnosis). No snippet-only sightings moved to unknowns.

protocol_metadata.about: StakeWise V3 is a decentralized liquid staking protocol for Ethereum and Gnosis Chain that allows users to stake ETH or GNO and receive osETH or osGNO, over-collateralized liquid staking tokens, in return. The protocol introduces a marketplace of modular staking Vaults, where any node operator can deploy a Vault with customizable parameters (fee, MEV strategy, DVT setup), and any user can stake into their preferred Vault. osETH is backed by more than 1 ETH per token held in a Vault, providing embedded slashing protection and DeFi composability. The protocol uses a mix of upgradeable contracts (governed via dual governance for keeping up with Ethereum PoS spec changes) and immutable contracts prioritizing security and self-custody.
